findings.title: Name the elapsed time as total offline-probe process time
findings.detail: The 10.882-second receipt measures the complete go run process, including potential compilation, file reads/hashes, private observation parsing, conversion and source recheck. The table labels this Offline conversion; use Offline probe process or Offline evaluation elapsed so it is not mistaken for measured Convert duration.
